title: fagus sylvatica f. atropunicea
intro: Fagus sylvatica f. atropunicea, commonly known as Purple Beech, is a cultivar of the European Beech tree, characterized by its distinctive reddish-purple foliage. The Purple Beech has been used in traditional medicine to promote overall health and well-being, offering potential benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of the Purple Beech include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
